messages.text: BL-1713 🎵 in progress — land_step_cli.bb printed LAND_CLEAN three times on 2026-09-24 (BL-1691 twice, BL-1694 once) for a built commit whose only change retired the ticket's standing-red register row - QA ran it from its worktree citing HEAD with the shared checkout as repo root, the CLI resolved HEAD there (origin/main), found nothing delivered and blessed the empty land; the CLI refuses a citation that means different commits in the caller's checkout and the repo root, and the plan refuses a range with no commit credited to the landing ticket
